config.qualification_scope: Predeclared hierarchical 4K/short/TTFT/concurrency screen; 32K/128K three-pair long-only battery required only if every screen metric passes. No promotion after screen failure.
config.repair: 79b0efc: dynamic descriptor range must not reject separate static slots 4..7. Original failed build data are retained and excluded; use three entirely fresh paired rounds.

method: Paired round percentile bootstrap, median log B/A, 20000 fixed-seed resamples; expand CI with conservative df=2 Student-t log-ratio interval. Marginal 95% intersection-union noninferiority. Bonferroni win CI across metrics and four predeclared candidates. Guard assumes independent normal log ratios; bootstrap alone is exploratory at small n.
